# DOMPurify

Version: **3.4.17**. Vendored from the official
[Cure53 repository](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/tree/3.4.17).

- `purify.min.js`: unmodified upstream `dist/purify.min.js`.
- `LICENSE`: upstream dual Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 license.

CMake embeds the script into the mdread executable. No npm, CDN, or network
connection is needed to build or run mdread. To update it, replace both files
from a pinned upstream release and run the HTTP and native window tests.
